description_en: Śaṅkhadhara Bāhāḥ is an independentvihāra. The building is located on the right-hand side of the street that leads from Bhelāchẽ to Cyāsal Square, and is easily identifiable thanks to the threephalcāsthat surround it. Onephalcāsits in front of the monument (to the west), the second is attached to the southern side of the building, and the third can be found to its north just across the street. The Bāhāḥ sits on a high plinth of 75 cm; this has been built using unusually large bricks. The decorativekasimvaḥandlibībricks are also larger than is characteristic for abāhāḥ. The sanctum can be accessed by climbing a series of steps that are flanked by two stone lions. The building has a single carved door on the ground floor of the main facade, which faces west. The door is guarded by a pair of terracotta serpents with a decorative brick lining.The upper floor is separated by a band of timber cornices with a pair oflhāḥkāat each of their projected ends. On the first floor, a carved window is set in the center of the main wall and has two small blind windows on either sides. The original struts, thetoraṇaand the roof structure are all missing. A new floor has been built on top of the first floor using brick masonry and mud mortar. This floor has a double-leaf glazed window. The building is now covered in corrugated metal sheets.The front yard is paved in stone. It has acaitya(225 cm high) on a square brick base and adharmadhātumaṇḍalalined up on its western axis.This independentvihārawas established by Śaṅkhadhara Prajāpati in 1868 (NS 988). The carved, brass entrance of the sanctum has notoraṇa,but it does have the usual two stone lions sitting in front of it. The main image of Akṣobhya has been lost, and since then the sanctum of the Bāhāḥ has remained empty. A photo printed inPruscha(1975, 176) shows stone pillars erected on the left-hand side of the plinth. These pillars are meant to hold a bell, however this too is missing. The pillars are also no longer there. To the left of the entrance, a small image of a four-handed Gaṇeśa has been placed in a small niche in the wall. Below this image, a stone inscription informs readers of the establishment of the Bāhāḥ. To the right of the entrance, one can find a small iamge of Kumāra riding on a peacock. An inscription mentions that Śaṅkhadhara Prajāpati established aguṭhīand provided it with land for the management of this Bāhāḥ. These days, however, the Bāhāḥ seems to be somewhat neglected. The ritual worship is also no longer performed.
description_ne: भेलाछेँबाट पूर्वतिरको गल्ली हुँदै च्यासल जाने बाटोको दक्षिणपट्टि शंखधर बाहा: रहेको छ । अन्य विहारमा जस्तो विहारभित्र पस्ने बाहिरी प्रवेशद्वार छैन, बाटोको छेउमै विहार बनाइएको छ । यो कुनै विहारको शाखा विहार नभई स्वतन्त्र निजी विहार हो । शंखधर प्रजापतिले नेसं ९८८ मा यो विहार बनाएका थिए । उनकै नामबाट विहारको नाम राखिएको हो । विहारको द्य:छेँ पश्चिमाभिमुख गरी बनाइएको छ । जस्तापाताले छाएको यो तलामा एउटा सिसाको झ्याल राखिएको छ । बीचको तलामा एउटा कलात्मक झ्याल छ । भुइँतलामा विहारको गर्भगृह रहेको छ । पहिले गर्भगृहभित्र अक्षोभ्य बुद्धको मूर्ति थियो तर उक्त मूर्ति चोरी भएपछि त्यहाँ अर्को मूर्ति राखिएको छैन, गर्भगृह खालि नै छ । गर्भगृहभित्र पस्ने पित्तलको पाताले मोडिएको ढोकामाथि तोरण भने छैन । ढोकाको बायाँपट्टि भित्तामा चार हात भएको गणेश राखिएको छ । गणेशको तल यो विहार स्थापना गर्दा राखिएको शिलापत्र छ । ढोकाको दायाँपट्टि मयूरमाथि चढेका कुमारको मूर्ति छ । ढोकाको अगाडि एक जोडी सिंह राखिएको छ । विहार प्राङ्गणमा एउटा चैत्य र एउटा धर्मधातु मण्डल राखिएको छ । विहारको दक्षिण, पश्चिम र उत्तर तीनै दिशामा फल्चाहरू बनाइएका छन् । विहारको तीन दिशामा फल्चाहरू भएको सम्भवत: यो नै एकमात्र विहार हो ।अहिले यो विहार तीन तलाको भए पनि निर्माण गरिँदा यो झिँगटीले छाइएको र छानालाई थाम्न पञ्चबुद्ध अंकित टुँडालहरू राखिएको दुई तलाको मात्र थियो (Pruscha 1975: 176) । अहिले झिंगटीको छाना हटाएर एक तला थपी जस्तापाताले छाइएको छ । प्रुस्चा 1975 (पृ. 176) मा छापिएको फोटोमा बायाँ पेटीमा घण्टा झुण्ड्याउन उभ्याइएका शिलास्तम्भ देखिन्छन् तर घण्टा देखिँदैन, अहिले ती शिलास्तम्भ समेत छैनन् ।शंखधर प्रजापतिले यो विहार बनाउँदा जग्गा दान गरी गुठी राखी विभिन्न सांस्कृतिक गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्ने बन्दोबस्त पनि गरेका थिए । तर अहिले विहारको भौतिक अवस्था पनि राम्रो छैन, सांस्कृतिक रूपले पनि यो विहार पूर्ण रूपले निष्क्रिय भइसकेको छ ।

historical_events.event_description: Prajāpati Thakura Śaṅkhadhara, resident of Cvachẽ, constructed the monastery with his wives Bhakhvāla Thakũ and Yacu. On that day, acaityaand adharmadhātumaṇḍalawere also installed in front of thedyaḥchẽ.

historical_events.event_name: Cladding the Caitya with copper repousse plate
historical_events.event_description: The Caitya was clad in copper repousse plate.
